clauses.clause: a false inclusion proof cannot satisfy inclusion verification;
an unauthenticated checkpoint cannot authorise an accepted tree root;
an unrelated log entry cannot authenticate a DSSE statement;
clauses.reason: the model's leaves are opaque bytes; DSSE statements, payload types and the A9/A10 binding are outside it (A23 and A9/A10 own them)

clauses.clause: a smaller checkpoint cannot silently roll back accepted state;
equal-size conflicting authenticated roots produce an incident;
unrelated log shards cannot satisfy a same-tree consistency obligation;
clauses.reason: the model has one origin and no shard transitions; cross-shard proof substitution is a tlog/monitor property, exercised by B5's controls

clauses.clause: duplicate witness credentials cannot satisfy independence thresholds;
an omitted required campaign activity cannot permit promotion;
clauses.reason: campaign opening, amendment and closure are A19/B3 machinery and have no representation in this state

clauses.clause: a revoked claim cannot satisfy a sufficiently fresh current-state policy;
missing timestamp evidence cannot satisfy a timestamp-dependent claim;
clauses.reason: the model records an observation instant but has no trusted-time authority or RFC 3161 evidence; B2 records no authority in this venue

clauses.clause: unavailable evidence cannot satisfy reconstruction requirements;
clauses.reason: archival reconstruction is B6's archive reader; the model has no archive members and no IO

clauses.clause: a publication failure cannot masquerade as transparent acceptance.

invariants.assumption: signatures are unforgeable and cover the exact note bytes; the model represents 'verified' as a boolean supplied by a signer/verifier pair it does not implement
invariants.check: no accepted checkpoint has signed == false
invariants.clause: an unauthenticated checkpoint cannot authorise an accepted tree root;
invariants.name: checkpoint-signature
invariants.statement: No checkpoint enters acceptedCheckpoints without a signature over its exact note bytes. Every observation carries a signature-valid flag; an unsigned observation is refused and leaves the state unchanged.

invariants.assumption: a checkpoint's tree size is the length of the leaf sequence it commits; leaf bytes are atomic
invariants.clause: a smaller checkpoint cannot silently roll back accepted state;
invariants.name: tree-size-monotone
invariants.statement: The tree sizes of accepted checkpoints never decrease: a checkpoint smaller than the largest accepted size is refused, not applied.

invariants.assumption: origins are atomic labels; the log is the only producer of its own checkpoints
invariants.check: no (origin, size) key maps to two roots among accepted checkpoints
invariants.clause: equal-size conflicting authenticated roots produce an incident;
invariants.name: one-root-per-origin-size
invariants.statement: For one origin and one tree size there is at most one accepted root; a second authenticated root at that size is refused as an incident.

invariants.assumption: leaf bytes are atomic; the RFC 6962 hash geometry is part of the model, not imported
invariants.check: root == root_of(committed); committed lengths agree; earlier committed prefixes persist; a mutated inclusion path fails
invariants.clause: a false inclusion proof cannot satisfy inclusion verification;
invariants.name: inclusion-persistence
invariants.statement: Every accepted checkpoint's root is the RFC 6962 root over the leaf sequence it commits; a leaf committed at size n is committed at the same index by every later accepted checkpoint; and the model's inclusion verifier accepts the true path and rejects a mutated one.

invariants.assumption: the corrected value is a new state version; the claim leaf's position is atomic
invariants.check: after a correction, lastUseVersion < correctedAt; the claim leaf is still at index 0; every honest checkpoint that committed it still does
invariants.clause: a revoked claim cannot satisfy a sufficiently fresh current-state policy;
invariants.name: withdrawn-is-not-current
invariants.statement: Once a subject is corrected or withdrawn, no present-tense use is accepted at that version or any later version, while the claim leaf's original inclusion at its index remains valid in every honest accepted checkpoint.

invariants.assumption: a domain is identified by its establishment record (path, sha256), not by its label
invariants.check: quorum == the number of distinct domains and never exceeds the label count
invariants.clause: duplicate witness credentials cannot satisfy independence thresholds;
invariants.name: witness-distinct-domains
invariants.statement: A witness quorum counts distinct operator domains, not labels: an alias of an established domain adds a label and does not raise the quorum.

invariants.assumption: the B6 current-state version is the number of covered correction events
invariants.clause: a smaller checkpoint cannot silently roll back accepted state;
invariants.name: state-version-monotone
invariants.statement: The current-state version never decreases: a correction advances it and no operation lowers it below the highest version the model has reached.

invariants.assumption: the classification policy is the B4 policy and a member's class is atomic
invariants.check: every published path is in PUBLIC_PATHS
invariants.clause: a publication failure cannot masquerade as transparent acceptance.
invariants.name: published-is-classified
invariants.statement: The published set contains only members the classification policy calls publishable; publishing a private member is refused, not recorded.

state: origin is one atomic label; leaves is an append-only sequence of opaque leaf strings; issued is the first and last checkpoint the log signed; accepted is the sequence of accepted checkpoints with the leaf sequence each commits; version/versionFloor are current-state counters; verdict/correctedAt/lastUseVersion are the subject's current state; published is the set of published members; witnessLabels/witnessDomains/quorum are the witness counts.
